head.dispatch: G-273 R-1 (2026-10-04 15:0x, 用户裁定「授权合成 fixture」)
head.inputBasisStatement: 本件全部产物均为合成件，一切结论标注「合成输入基准」，不冒称真实数据评测
head.determinism: pure functions of (seed, grid, declared parameter types); no clock, no RNG; pool bytes identical to the r1 build pinned by evidence-index-2.md
head.zeroExecution: no Pro, no MCP, no tools/call, no GP invocation, no GIS write

measurementDomain.georefConvention: GeoTIFF ModelTiepoint(33922)(0,0)->upper-left + RasterPixelIsArea; ESRI ASCII xll/yll = lower-left (both written and re-parsed here)

head.honestyDiscipline: 全量 synthetic 标注（逐件 `synthetic: true`＋`lineage`）；executableInputAvailable 仅在逐件参数全可承载时为 true；准入态一律 NOT VERIFIED

calibrationChoice.choiceBasis: G-273 R-1 授权逐件合成合格输入；类型化输入池＋逐件参数映射（同 EPSG/同格网/同范围），先例＝D-101 组复用；本轮把承载从「按声明类型」收紧为「按 (件, 参数) 语义钉位」

head.crsDeviationDisclosed: vector pool carries planar metres inside a GeoJSON-shaped document (not RFC 7946 lon/lat) — labelled, not hidden

frozenSurfacesUntouched.note: additive only; the 78 artefacts, every frozen member and the r1 pool/faces are untouched

rectification.defect: r1 keyed carriers on the declared parameter type, so every raster slot received the DEM and six pool artefacts went unreferenced
rectification.foundBy: L2 executor, pre-delivery re-read of perToolPlan (not reported by the commander)
rectification.correction: 37 (tool, parameter) carrier pins plus 3 name-driven literal rules; pool bytes unchanged, faces additive (v1 kept)

ruleCensus.note: declared-but-unfired rule ids are vocabulary, not evidence of coverage

unreferencedPoolItems.reason: multi-band control that reproduces the in-case ERROR 000864 face; declared NOT a qualifying input for single-band parameters

attrs.whatItIs: attribute table whose id values overlap both vector pools
attrs.lineage: CSV id,value,grp with ids A1..A5/B1..B3 overlapping both vector pools (r1 lines 144-153)

classes.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)
classes.lineage: 1 + ((i*3 + j*5) %% 4) integer class grid, domain 1..4 (r1 line 67)

classesAsc.format: ESRI ASCII grid (int class codes 1-4, NoData -9999)
classesAsc.whatItIs: lower-left origin grid on the same measurement domain
classesAsc.lineage: the same class grid written as an ESRI ASCII grid with lower-left origin (r1 lines 104-112)

dem.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)
dem.whatItIs: int16 DEM, 4x3 NoData hole at rows 20-23/cols 30-33
dem.lineage: int16 elevation grid, formula 2000 + 40*((i*7 + j*11) %% 31) - 2*j, with a 4x3 NoData hole at rows 20-23 / cols 30-33 (r1 build_pool lines 63 and 71-82)

events.whatItIs: xy-event table with a time column (space-time / event-driven tools)
events.lineage: CSV event_id,x,y,value,t, six events on grid points with ISO timestamps (r1 lines 154-159)

featuresJson.claimLimit: declared as a document carrier only; whether it satisfies the tool's expected JSON schema is NOT VERIFIED until Phase B
featuresJson.lineage: GeoJSON document carrier for the JSON-to-features face (r1 JSON writer)

flowacc.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)

flowdir.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)
flowdir.lineage: 1 << ((i + j) %% 6), with 128 wherever the DEM value is a multiple of 7 — codes stay inside the Esri set 1/2/4/8/16/32/64/128 (r1 line 65)

lines.format: GeoJSON (planar metres, EPSG:32651, closed rings; declared deviation: coordinates are projected, so the document is not RFC 7946-compliant — labelled, not hidden)
lines.lineage: one polyline feature L1 through px(4,4)/px(20,14)/px(44,40) (r1 line 118)

negative3band.format: GeoTIFF (3 bands, byte-identical copies of one band)
negative3band.whatItIs: multi-band control that reproduces the in-case ERROR 000864 face; declared NOT a qualifying input for single-band parameters
negative3band.lineage: three byte-identical copies of the DEM band (r1 lines 93-102); declared a negative control

points.format: GeoJSON (planar metres, EPSG:32651, closed rings; declared deviation: coordinates are projected, so the document is not RFC 7946-compliant — labelled, not hidden)
points.lineage: six point features P1..P6 on the shared grid (r1 lines 120-121)

polys_a.format: GeoJSON (planar metres, EPSG:32651, closed rings; declared deviation: coordinates are projected, so the document is not RFC 7946-compliant — labelled, not hidden)
polys_a.lineage: three polygon features A1..A3 built by poly() on the shared grid (r1 lines 116, 122-142)

polys_b.format: GeoJSON (planar metres, EPSG:32651, closed rings; declared deviation: coordinates are projected, so the document is not RFC 7946-compliant — labelled, not hidden)
polys_b.whatItIs: two polygon features, ids B1..B2 (overlay partner)
polys_b.lineage: two polygon features B1..B2, the overlay partner (r1 lines 117, 122-142)

remap.whatItIs: VALUE remap table for Reclassify-family tools
remap.lineage: value-remap table over the class domain 1..4 (r1 remap writer)

slope.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)
slope.whatItIs: int16 slope-like raster (derived from the same DEM formula)
slope.lineage: abs(dem[j][i] - dem[j][i+1]) // 4, i.e. derived from the same DEM formula (r1 line 64)
